# Linux's rtw89 bringing up ryzen's RTL8852CE, interface-up through `fw ready`:
# every register access in order, as offsets into BAR2. Stage W0, run 2,
# 2026-10-06 (overlays/ryzen/w0-trace.sh; docs/archive/AKUMA_AMD64_ON_RYZEN_LAPTOP.md § 5.1).
#
# Made with:
#   python3 overlays/ryzen/w0-summary.py <run>/mmiotrace.txt.gz --dump up --collapse | head -639
# — runs of identical lines folded into one (polls), cut at the first read of
# WCPU_FW_CTRL with status 7. The first line is not from the "up" phase: it is
# the chip-cut read (SYS_CFG1) from the same run's probe, which the bring-up
# makes first. Ring base writes (*_DESA_L/H) are Linux IOMMU addresses; the
# replay test does not compare them. No efuse reads are in this window.
